terra.problem: The comparison mixes two images: a tree planted firmly and flour blowing around.

The passage does not say that Paul wants readers to see the two events together.

Saying the whole group saw Christ adds a detail the passage does not state.
The explanation of the Twelve as disciples Jesus chose needs a reference outside this passage.
